Kawerongo - Newsletters

Every month our librarians put together newsletters highlighting upcoming events and new services, as well as putting the spotlight on regular programmes that our libraries offer.

Keep up to date with our special events, eLibrary resources, new books and blog posts. To receive these in your inbox every month, choose the subjects you are interested in, and fill in the form to subscribe.

  • General Newsletter
    Get the latest books, events, staff picks & more in our monthly newsletter—delivered straight to your inbox!

  • Business Newsletter
    Stay ahead in business with our monthly newsletter—books, events & tools for entrepreneurs. Subscribe now!

  • Music Notes Newsletter
    Love discovering new music? Get fresh picks, new arrivals, and hidden gems in your inbox each month with Music Notes.

  • Kids and Families Newsletter
    Subscribe to our monthly newsletter highlighting upcoming events, new services, regular programmes and more.

  • Youth Newsletter
    Subscribe to our monthly Newsletter to learn more about Hijinks, Shenanigans, Tomfoolery, and other such opportunities.

  • Movie Nights
    Get fortnightly emails with the movies we will be showing at Te Matapihi ki te Ao Nui Central Library.
